# Linegra — agent-oriented site index (llms.txt)
# https://linegra.app

> Linegra is a genealogy archive with interactive pedigree views, GEDCOM import/export,
> family books, and AI-assisted research. Public content is read-only; living and private
> persons are excluded from crawl indexes.

## Public URL patterns

- Site home: https://linegra.app/
- Public tree landing: https://linegra.app/tree/{treeUuid}
- Public person profile: https://linegra.app/tree/{treeUuid}/person/{personUuid}
- Shared family book: https://linegra.app/book/{bookUuid}

Legacy query URLs (`?tree=&person=`) redirect to the canonical paths above.

## Machine-readable alternates

- Sitemap: https://linegra.app/sitemap.xml
- Person JSON: https://linegra.app/api/public/person/{personUuid}
- Person Markdown: https://linegra.app/api/public/person/{personUuid}?format=md
- Person HTML (crawler shell): https://linegra.app/api/public/person/{personUuid}?format=html
- Tree index HTML: https://linegra.app/api/public/tree/{treeUuid}?format=html

## Privacy rules

- Only `is_public` family trees appear in indexes.
- Living persons, private profiles (`is_private`), and restricted notes/media are omitted.
- Family books must be explicitly shared (`is_public`) and marked complete.

## Documentation

- Product overview: https://linegra.app (human UI)
- Repository wiki (behavior, schema, roadmap): see project `wiki/` in source.

## Contact

Use the in-app administrator flow for tree access requests. Do not scrape authenticated `/records` routes.
